title: Saliva Sample Transfer from Tuberacks to 96 Well Plate
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set up deck and tube racks
steps.instruction: Place the six 4‑in‑4 tube racks containing 25 mL saliva tubes on the left side of the deck: slots 10, 11, 7, 8 form Tuberack Quadrant 1 and slots 4, 5, 1, 2 form Tuberack Quadrant 2. Ensure the first three tube slots in Quadrant 1 are empty (no sample tubes). If more than 45 samples are needed, be prepared to replace these racks later with a second set of tube racks.

steps.title: Set temperature module
steps.instruction: If a temperature module with an aluminum block is positioned on the deck, set its temperature to the value specified in the protocol parameter before any liquid handling.

steps.title: Transfer first set of samples
steps.instruction: Using the first set of tubes, transfer saliva to the 96‑well plate in a zig‑zag pattern (top‑left → top‑right → bottom‑left → bottom‑right). Skip wells A1‑A3 (control wells). Transfer in row order from each tuberack quadrant to the corresponding target quadrant: Quadrant 1 tubes → Target Quadrant 1 (A1‑D6, with A1‑A3 unused) and Quadrant 2 tubes → Target Quadrant 2 (A7‑D12).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate from each tube in row order.
Dispense into the matching well of the target quadrant.
Proceed sequentially through all tubes in Quadrant 1, then Quadrant 2.

steps.title: Swap tube racks
steps.instruction: If a second set of tube racks is required, pause the protocol, remove the first set of racks, and replace them with the second set on the same deck positions.

steps.title: Transfer second set of samples
steps.instruction: From the second set of tubes, transfer saliva to the remaining quadrants of the 96‑well plate: Quadrant 1 tubes → Target Quadrant 3 (E1‑H6) and Quadrant 2 tubes → Target Quadrant 4 (E7‑H12). Maintain the same row‑order and zig‑zag pattern, and continue to skip any control wells (none in these quadrants).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate from each tube in row order.
Dispense into the matching well of the target quadrant.
Complete all transfers for Quadrant 3 then Quadrant 4.
